name: EOY Music, Comics & Arts Festival
blurb: A Japanese pop-culture festival in Singapore with cosplay and idol stage shows, J-pop and anime music, and an independent creators' market.
notes: Most recent confirmed edition (27-28 Dec 2025, Raffles City Convention Centre) already ended before the research window (must end on/after 2026-10-05). The nav shows a 'Booth Registration (2026)' link, so the organizer is clearly preparing a 2026 edition, but no dates for it are posted anywhere on the site yet, so editions is empty per the no-dates-announced rule. Site title/branding now reads 'EOY Music, Comics & Arts Festival' (also 'EOY J-Culture Festival' in copy); kept the given id since EOY is the stable short name. Guests were not pulled since no in-window edition exists yet.
